name: CM31_behaviour_is_numbered
origins: user requirement 2026-10-21 (GCD of functions, Gödel numbering)
statement: A function's canonical form (its shortest annihilating recurrence and initial terms, found from behaviour and checked on unused terms) and the form's Gödel number name its redefinition class; every form of an algorithm card shares one number; identities between functions (shift, composition, cofactor, shared operator) are witnessed as theorems, and verified fast forms carry into improve.
